## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve the physics sandbox as a separate mode.
- Support keyboard focus and reduced motion.
- Use the custom DevX render engines as the source of visuals.

### Avoid

- Generic glass dashboard cards.
- Excessive gradients.
- Sacred iconography assigned to the wrong figure.

## Decisions

- Garuda is white with dense gold ornamentation and layered spread wings.
- The hero scene includes Vishnu as an optional rider, enabled by default.
- The viewer remains separate from the physics sandbox.
- The final render target is 1920x1080; previews use lower resolution.
